div.div:
Points ledger (ADR-0048). Every balance change Puts its points-transactions row in the same TransactWriteItems that moves PROFILE Score. The TransactionId is deterministic — CHALLENGE#, REVIEW#<productId>, REDEMPTION#<orderId> — and is the idempotency key.
Redemption lifecycle. Reserved (or Failed, nothing debited) at checkout → Used when the payment is authorized → Released / Refunded when the order is cancelled. Points only: the conversion and the 20% cap are Pricing's.
Sparse GSI1. Only the PUBLIC item carries the projection attributes; the ANSWER item is structurally unreachable through the public read path.
